TranslatedDistribution

class uncertain_variables.distributions.TranslatedDistribution.TranslatedDistribution(dist, shift, scale, center=None)[source]

Bases: Distribution

Distribution obtained by applying an affine transformation to another base distribution.

Underlying base distribution.

Distribution

static translate_points_forward(x, shift, scale, center)[source]

Apply the forward affine transformation:

y = (x - center) * scale + center + shift

Parameters:

  • x (array_like) – Values from the base distribution.

  • shift (float) – Translation offset.

  • scale (float) – Scaling factor.

  • center (float) – Center of scaling.

Returns:

y – Transformed points.

Return type:

array_like

static translate_points_backwards(x, shift, scale, center)[source]

Apply the inverse affine transformation:

x = (y - shift - center) / scale + center

Parameters:

  • x (array_like) – Values from the translated distribution.

  • shift (float) – Translation offset.

  • scale (float) – Scaling factor.

  • center (float) – Center of scaling.

Returns:

y – Points mapped back to the base distribution domain.

Return type:

array_like

static translate_moments(m, shift, scale, center)[source]

Transform the moments of a distribution under an affine transformation.

Parameters:

  • m (list) – Moments of the base distribution in the form [mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis].

  • shift (float) – Translation offset.

  • scale (float) – Scaling factor.

  • center (float) – Center of scaling.

Returns:

m – Transformed moments.

Return type:

list
